title: Change what I am wearing
why: Every change goes through one OutfitDirector on my Forge wardrobe, whoever asks, so I always know what I'm wearing and why.

steps.title: See what I can wear
steps.why: Only approved looks with a file can be worn.

steps.title: Put a look on
steps.why: A person can also just say “wear the copper-rose coat”; that goes through the same director without a model call.

steps.title: Choose by occasion on my own
steps.why: OutfitAutopilot checks every 5 minutes: late at night → home look; presenting/meeting → coat; building/training/lab → catsuit; otherwise my usual outfit. A look a person chose is kept for 2 hours. Turn off with localStorage lelu.outfit.autopilot = off.
